notes.title: Hangoverse V0.0.5 is live
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45225385/353ae5f0a61e96e0603299c691b23e713a8bf918.jpg[/img]

Hi!

Before complaining as I usually do, here are the things to know about this update:

- 10k words

- 2 CG sets

- 2~ lewd scenes

Now, for the complaining. First, I'm trying my best to make the game feel a bit more 'NTR', but I was probably stupid to have it be so focused on comedy. Makes it seem as though nothing is really important.

Also, one of the scenes, I directed poorly. With this project, because I need to give my artist work constantly, oftentimes, I don't have the script ready (or even started) because I'm waiting for the results of the polls, and I need to give a scene description to my artist. So this kind of became a mismatch of what I actually had in mind. In any case, I feel like I wasted a CG for something that didn't need one.

Lastly, I was stupid enough to think that releasing this retarded game on Steam for free could somehow be worth it. Instead, all I gain is people complaining in the reviews even though I'm giving the game away. I won't lie when I say that I'm actually questioning myself on developing this project at all. Seems like my effort could be put into something that actually has worth. Maybe it's just because of the negativity surrounding it. I should probably not listen to outsiders, but even I can be affected by negativity sometimes.

In any case, as of right now, this project will be put on pause while I organize my thoughts. I will probably be working on another project instead, and depending on how it goes with that project, I will decide what to do with Hangoverse. I know some people really like this project, but some things should take priority over others. And this project is not that important, let's be honest.

[b]Changelog V0.0.5[/b]
[b]Story[/b]

[*] Added 2 CG sets
[*] Added 10k~ words to the story
[*] 2 lewd scenes
[/list]
